runner.description: Repository of the runner image built from services/runner/Dockerfile.

fixture.description: Repository of the fixture image built from services/fixture/Dockerfile; also runs finite batch Jobs.

tag.description: Published immutable image tag shared by the runner and fixture images; build and push both before running.

rate.description: Offered activations per second; independent of response completion. Excess arrivals are counted as skipped.

duration.description: Arrival window in seconds; outstanding requests drain afterwards.

max_requests.description: Total arrival cap per run, including skipped arrivals; bounds retained receipt growth.

concurrency.description: Maximum in-flight requests including completion polling; distinct from batch activation parallelism.

timeout.description: Deadline in seconds for observing a terminal activation state; timeouts do not cancel executions.

request_timeout.description: Socket timeout in seconds for each fixture or operator call; must not exceed timeout.

poll_interval.description: Seconds between receipt reads; a smaller interval also increases read load.

batchDelaySeconds.description: Simulated processing time in each real Kubernetes batch Job; does not simulate CPU consumption.

nodeSelector.description: Node labels required by every fixture, batch and runner Pod. Empty uses normal scheduling.

tolerations.description: Taints these Pods may tolerate; combine with nodeSelector to choose the experiment pool.

resources.description: Per-container requests and limits for the runner, fixture and batch. Hold constant when comparing operator settings.

secretName.description: Existing Secret in the graph namespace with separate operator and fixture tokens. Empty is only for a private operator with authentication disabled.

operatorTokenKey.description: Secret key holding a Polyad credential permitted to submit and read activations in this graph tree.

fixtureTokenKey.description: Secret key holding a separate token authenticating the runner to the fixture; never reuse the operator credential.

replicas.description: Desired fixture Pods and concurrent batch Jobs, independently of operator replica settings.

batch.description: Maximum concurrent operator-created batch Jobs; keep expanded graphs within the study GraphRule.

reloadOnPlanChange.description: Opt the fixture Deployment into ConfigMap-triggered Reloader restarts. Requires bundled or existing Reloader; apply plan changes between runs.

description: Benchmark images, bounded arrivals and graph-managed Pod settings.
